name: CSO_GSR_REQUEST
description: This table defines (the summary of) every GFR (Global Find and Replace) Request Content.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: BYPASS_WORKFLOW
columns.description: A flag to indicating whether the user wanted GFR to bypass workflow when updating/publishing content.

columns.name: DATE_ADDED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the record was added.

columns.name: DATE_COMPLETED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the entire GFR Request was completed - inserted only when it is allowed to run until completion.

columns.name: DATE_MODIFIED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the record was modified - updated every time user stops/starts GFR job.

columns.name: FIND_TEXT
columns.description: This is the text that user wanted GFR to find.

columns.name: MATCH_CASE
columns.description: A flag to indicating whether the user wanted GFR to match the case when finding text.

columns.name: MATCH_WHOLE_WORDS_ONLY
columns.description: A flag to indicating whether the user wanted GFR to match whole words only when finding text.

columns.name: NUM_DOCS_SELECTED
columns.description: This is the number of documents that user selected and expects GFR to replace.

columns.name: REPLACE_TEXT
columns.description: This is the text that user wanted to replace with.

columns.name: RETAIN_CASE
columns.description: A flag to indicating whether the user wanted GFR to maintain the case in the original document when replacing.

columns.name: REQUEST_STATE
columns.description: A value which indicates the current state of this GFR job e.g: Stopped, Running, Completed, etc.

columns.name: SITE_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to the Site (Repository) in which this GFR Request was made.

columns.name: SUPPRESS_NOTIFICATION_TO_OWNER
columns.description: A flag to indicate whether the user wanted GFR to suppress Publish Notifications to Owner.

columns.name: SUPPRESS_SUBSCRIPTIONS
columns.description: A flag to indicate whether the user wanted GFR to suppress Subscription Notifications.

columns.name: SUPPRESS_TRANSLATION
columns.description: A flag to indicate whether the user wanted GFR to suppress Translation Requests, Tasks, and Notifications.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: This is the obsolete GUID reference to the user who made the GFR Request.

columns.name: LAST_MODIFIED_BY
columns.description: This is the obsolete GUID reference to the user who last modified the GFR Request.

columns.name: USER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This is the party ID reference to the user who made the GFR Request.

columns.name: LAST_MODIFIED_BY_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This is the party ID reference to the user who last modified the GFR Request.
